sources.title: OpenTimelineIO Writing an Adapter
sources.locator: Lossless native .otio serialization, adapter lossiness, metadata support and namespace guidance.
sources.observed_operation: Read official versioned documentation; no adapter or round-trip test run.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_exceptions: The native OTIO JSON adapter can store/retrieve OTIO objects, metadata, and supported OTIO features; external adapters may be lossy. The core carries custom metadata without interpreting it, and docs recommend a namespace.
sources.applicability: A native OTIO project with versioned namespaced application metadata is a viable architecture candidate; this does not prove that the required media semantics or downstream adapters are lossless.
